title: The best way to ask forgiveness
cue: "You are my Lord, there is no god but You…"
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، اغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
transliteration: Allaahumma anta rabbee, laa ilaha illaa ant, khalaqtanee wa'anaa 'abduk, wa'anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wawa'dika mastata't, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana't, aboo'u laka bini'matika 'alayy, wa'aboo'u bidhanbee, ighfir lee, fa'innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa ant
translation: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I keep to Your covenant and Your promise as far as I am able. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge to You Your favour upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. Forgive me, for no one forgives sins but You.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih al-Bukhari, al-Sultaniyya print, hadith 6306: https://shamela.ws/book/1681/9452

provenance.note: The printed al-Sultaniyya text on Shamela reads وأبوء بذنبي، اغفر لي; hadith-api reads وأبوء لك بذنبي، فاغفر لي. We follow the printed edition.

usage.evidence: The Prophet ﷺ said that whoever says it by day, certain of it, and dies that day before evening, is among the people of Paradise; and the same for whoever says it by night and dies before morning (al-Bukhari 6306).
